title: dark-factory project profile
description: Contents of .factory/profile.json in a consumer project. The profile only adds project-specific values to the factory core; it cannot remove or override anything the core ships. Every element is off unless the profile enables it.

$schema.description: Optional reference to this schema, for editor support.

branchTemplate.description: Branch name template for task branches. Placeholders: {issue} (issue number) and {slug} (title slug), for example "task/ISSUE-{issue}-{slug}".

githubProject.description: Optional number of the GitHub Project the project issues are tracked in.

apps.description: Application layout of the project. A single-package project lists one app with path "."; a monorepo lists one app per package.

name.description: Short app name, unique within the profile.

path.description: App directory relative to the project root; "." for a package in the root.

install.description: Dependency installation steps run in a fresh clone, in order. Optional; no steps by default.

gate.description: Gate commands run for this app before a commit, in order. Optional; no gate by default.

docOnlyPathPatterns.description: Glob patterns of paths whose changes are documentation only and do not count as code changes.

protectedPaths.description: Glob patterns of paths the Ralph agent must not change.

labels.description: GitHub label names used by the factory.

humanNeeded.description: Label that marks an issue or PR as needing a human.

verifier.description: Acceptance Verifier settings. The verdict itself is computed by code; these values only locate inputs and name the result.

verdictCheckName.description: Name of the status check that carries the verifier verdict.

goldenDir.description: Directory of reference cases (inputs with an expected verdict), relative to the project root. The golden eval reads its cases only from here; without it the eval fails instead of using a default.

checks.description: Names of the deterministic verifier checks that run for this project (core checks: spec-approval, affects-scope, computed-items, test-tampering-scan, references, ci-checks, allowed-model). Checks not listed stay off; none run by default. A name no registered check has fails the verdict.

skillRules.description: Project entries of the shared "path to skills" table. They are added to the core table and cannot remove or override its entries.

path.description: Path prefix, relative to the project root, that the entry applies to.

extensions.description: File extensions (with the leading dot) that the entry applies to.

label.description: Human-readable label of the entry, shown in hook messages.

skills.description: Names of skills that must be loaded before editing matching files.

extraMetaskills.description: Names of metaskills installed in the project in addition to the base set of the package.

ruleFiles.description: Project rule files (for example a CLAUDE.md) that agents must read, relative to the project root.

overlays.description: Project overlays of document templates, relative to .factory/overlays/. An overlay can only add to a core template.

prd.description: Overlay file for the PRD template.

plan.description: Overlay file for the plan template.

issue.description: Overlay file for the issue template.

docs.description: Locations of project documents, relative to the project root.

hooks.description: Commands of the lint and typecheck hooks. A hook is inactive for paths that no entry matches.

agentEnvironment.description: Environment constraints stated to the Ralph agent in its prompt (for example tools that are unavailable). The sandbox section is added by a later schema revision.

ralph.description: Ralph, the autonomous issue-executing agent. Off unless "enabled" is true; a disabled Ralph needs no other fields.

enabled.description: Whether Ralph runs in this project. When false, no other ralph field is required.

techDebtTrackerIssue.description: Number of the issue that collects tech-debt items. Required when Ralph is enabled.

enabledSteps.description: Names of optional Ralph steps switched on for this project. Steps not listed stay off. Required (may be empty) when Ralph is enabled.

command.description: A command as an argument array (not a shell string) plus its working directory.

cwd.description: Working directory relative to the project root; "." for the root.

hookCommand.description: A hook command bound to the paths it applies to.

paths.description: Glob patterns of the paths the command applies to.
